data.description: The set of actions available to a seat depends on whether there is a live bet to answer, whether the seat still has chips, and whether it is still in the hand. A seat that cannot act offers no actions at all rather than a no-op.

situations.note: Calling is available and checking is not, because there is a live bet.
situations.situation: first to act before the flop, facing the big blind

situations.note: An all-in seat has nothing left to decide, so no action is legal.
situations.situation: a seat that is already all-in
